strict_configuration: App-owned config and private DB; exact provider/endpoint/package/API model and request body; all allowed agent models pinned; unpinned delegates denied.
quota_note: After earlier successful free inference, HTTP429 free usage limit responses also blocked simple coding. Redundant retries were stopped. Captured CLI error responses exposed body only, with no Retry-After headers or reset time metadata recorded.
synthetic_validation: 35 focused tests including real installed CLI against synthetic local protocol, hostile global/project model/body/baseURL settings, readonly context permissions and rejection of unpinned custom delegates.
